verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26860304 from Hwaseong Memory for PO 4500318705 (dated 2026-07-28), FOB Busan, NET45. It confirms two lines for the same material CMP-GAM-002 (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5): 13,000 pcs at 5.4 USD confirmed for 2026-09-29, and 12,000 pcs at 5.56 USD confirmed for 2026-10-05. Total 25,000 pcs. The document is clean, with no handwriting or corrections.
red_flags: The same material CMP-GAM-002 appears on two lines at different unit prices (5.4 USD vs 5.56 USD). The buyer should check both against the PO.
The two lines have different confirmed dates (2026-09-29 and 2026-10-05), so delivery is split.
The document carries no issue date of its own; only the PO date 2026-07-28 is shown.
The quantity column has no unit of measure stated, and the confirmation does not say whether the quantities match the original PO.
observations: Clean printed single-page document with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or visible damage.
The heading is bilingual (Korean/English); the rest is in English.
The Qty column is read as the confirmed quantity because this is an order confirmation. The original ordered quantity is not shown.
